title: Admin order tracking number management and post-submit payment instruction toast

requirements.summary: Update Admin Panel to add/edit per-order tracking numbers (only when not pending) and persist updates with toast feedback and React Query refetching.
acceptanceCriteria: For each order in the admin orders list, there is a tracking number input/display area.
When an order status is pending, the tracking number input is hidden or disabled with a clear UI indication that tracking is available only after pending.
When an order status is approved or shipped, the admin can save/update the tracking number and receives a success toast on completion and an error toast on failure.
After saving, the Admin Panel reflects the updated tracking number without a manual refresh (via React Query invalidation/refetch).

file_operations.description: Create a React Query mutation hook that calls the backend capability to set/update an order tracking number and invalidates relevant order queries on success. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Ensure query keys support invalidating admin order list and individual order detail after a tracking-number update (reuse existing keys where possible).

Add a tracking number UI per order in the admin list: show current tracking number when present; render an editable input + save action only when status is approved/shipped; disable or hide input for pending with a clear message; wire to the new useSetTrackingNumber mutation; show success/error toasts using the existing sonner toast pattern; invalidate/refetch orders after save so the list updates without manual refresh. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Display an order’s tracking number on the Order Details page only when it exists.
acceptanceCriteria: If the order has a tracking number, Order Details displays it in a readable field/section.
If the order has no tracking number, Order Details does not show a misleading empty value.

file_operations.description: Add a readable 'Tracking Number' field/section that conditionally renders only when order.trackingNumber is present; avoid rendering placeholder/empty values when missing.

requirements.summary: After successful order submission, show a notification popup/toast instructing users to contact the owner for payment methods.
acceptanceCriteria: On successful order creation, the UI shows a notification/toast that reads exactly: "Please contact the owner for payment methods".
The notification appears after a successful submission (not on validation errors or backend failures).
The existing success flow (e.g., navigation to the dashboard) still occurs.

file_operations.description: On successful createOrder.mutateAsync completion, display a sonner toast whose text is exactly "Please contact the owner for payment methods" and still navigate to the dashboard; ensure the message is not shown on validation errors or failed submissions. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
